systems.platform: delivered through the Houwiyeti application and the Khidmati portal
systems.owner: Ministère de la Justice, with MTNIMA and ANRPTS
systems.tiers: citizens obtain their record remotely, without going to the judicial services; launched 28 March 2025

note: The criminal record and its online delivery: an identification system of the justice ministry, not a station record. The minister says digitisation will later extend to criminal and commercial procedure from the registration of cases to judgments, a statement about the courts; nothing on police or gendarmerie stations.
